name: io.github.flashdata-dev/youtube-autocomplete
title: YouTube Autocomplete — FlashData
description: YouTube autocomplete suggestions by query prefix, language and region. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with youtube_suggestions access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Build a YouTube autocomplete keyword research sheet
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read the suggestion strings in results[0]. Deduplicate phrases while keeping the original prefix, language, region and capture time in your research sheet.
dev.flashdata.limits: Autocomplete returns phrases, not video results or search-volume estimates. A suggestion is not evidence of demand size.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
